_review: W_NEXT_NOT_LOADED: horde_zephras_05-10 is written next, as the second band of this isle. Its entry starts at this exitPoint (Shen'dar Village, level 5) and it takes over the dropped Highlands quests.

W_TRAINER_GAP: the expected-level simulation has no XP for these Forever quests, so every trainer sits at level 1 and the gap runs to the band end. Real trainer visits are level 2 (Thendal), level 4 (Thendal) and level 5 (Shen'dar), so the real gap is at most 2 levels.

W_XP_RANGE: no XP row exists in data/raw for any quest in zephras_01-05 (PROGRESS phase 02 and 03b notes), so the validator counts 0 of the 4800 budget. The band is paced by steps and level ranges, not measured XP; re-check in game.

dropped.reason: Hippogryph Protectors and the Matriarch are level 6-7, two to three above a level 4-5 player. Handed to zephras_05-10.
Highlands Bandits and Badwind Bennic are level 7, too high at the level 5 exit. Handed to zephras_05-10 with the bandit camp.
Chain head of Meddlesome Mages. The mage rewards need level 10 and 16. Handed to zephras_05-10.
Pilfered Windstones drop from the same level 7 bandit camp as The Criminal Element. Handed to zephras_05-10.
Hippogryph Down from the level 6-7 hippogryphs in the south-west. Handed to zephras_05-10 with Hippogryph Harassment.
High Order Apprentices (levels 5-6) with Idol (needs level 16) and Totem (needs level 10) rewards. Handed to zephras_05-10.

steps.note: Ailee Farheart starts you in Thendal Grove. A short intro, then report to Rorian.
steps.title: Coming of Age

steps.note: Rorian the Dayseeker is the hub for the first Thendal quests.
steps.title: Coming of Age

steps.note: Eight Juvenile Vuldrens sit east of the watchtower. Rorian gives you this one.
steps.title: Harmony in Balance

steps.note: Elemental Unrest is a speaking quest: Yala Windwatcher, east of Rorian.
steps.title: Elemental Unrest

steps.note: Pesky Cirrusflies are just south-east of Elatrell Featherlight.
steps.title: Infestation Investigation

steps.note: Slay 8 Juvenile Vuldrens east of the watchtower, close to the Cirrusflies.
Pesky Cirrusflies on the same patch. Kill 8 of them.
Back to Elatrell Featherlight for the Cirrusfly Queen next.
steps.title: Infestation Investigation

steps.note: The Cirrusfly Queen is a lone level 3 mob south-east of Elatrell.
steps.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

steps.note: Cirrusfly Queen, alone in the hills south-east of the watchtower.
Hand in at Elatrell. Watcher's Mail Chest is the armour pick for mail wearers.

reward.why: Warriors and Paladins: mail is the first big armour step (il 5). Leather users: Exterminator's Vest.

steps.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

steps.note: Back to Rorian. Vuldren Hide Bracers are the first leather upgrade.

reward.why: Leather bracers: the first armour step here (il 5). Fur-Lined Shoes are the alternative.

steps.title: Harmony in Balance

steps.note: Dalia the Collector wants Windstone Clusters from the raw windstones by the Vuldrens.
steps.title: Harvesting Windstones

steps.note: Raw Windstone spawns just east of the watchtower, beside the Vuldren patch.
Back to Dalia the Collector.
steps.title: Harvesting Windstones

steps.note: Stunt quest: jump from the watchtower top with Walk on Air. Skip it if you lack the ability.
steps.title: Falling With Style

steps.note: Jump from the top of the Thendal watchtower and use Walk on Air to slow the fall.
Back to Rorian once you have made the jump.
steps.title: Falling With Style

steps.note: Halaan Hawk-Eye lends you a gift to view the anchor pylon. Only a quick talk, no mobs.
steps.title: The Anchors of Zephras

steps.note: Look at the anchor pylon with Halaan's gift, then hand the quest back to Halaan here.
steps.title: The Anchors of Zephras

steps.note: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence beside Yala. Skip if no Skysight.
steps.title: The Gift of Skysight

steps.note: Hunters: read the Scribbled Note Rorian gives you, then see Tai'ree Farsight.
steps.title: The Way of the Hunter

steps.note: Rogues: read the Simple Note, then find Akeri Duskblade inside the watchtower.
steps.title: At Home in the Shadows

steps.note: Shamans: take Embracing the Elements here. Examine the crystal, then Windshaper Boro.
steps.title: Embracing the Elements

steps.note: Druids: read the Folded Parchment, then speak with Xyton Silverwind.
steps.title: A Student of Nature

steps.note: Warriors: read the Crumpled Note, then seek out Blademaster Ren in the watchtower.
steps.title: The Warrior's Path

steps.note: Tai'ree Farsight is the Hunter trainer here. Learn your first skills.
steps.title: The Way of the Hunter

steps.note: Akeri Duskblade is in the watchtower. Learn your first Rogue skills.
steps.title: At Home in the Shadows

steps.note: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal in the grove first, then speak with Windshaper Boro.
steps.title: Embracing the Elements

steps.note: Xyton Silverwind is the Druid trainer here. Learn your first skills.
steps.title: A Student of Nature

steps.note: Blademaster Ren is the Warrior trainer here. Learn your first skills.
steps.title: The Warrior's Path

steps.note: About level 2: visit your class trainer here. Mages: Shen'dar. Priests, Paladins: Thunder Bluff. Warlocks: Razor Hill.
Shamans: Call of Earth needs a Signet of Akir from the Al'Aketh Converts just east of here.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Yala Windwatcher, east of Rorian. Then the Agitators.
steps.title: Elemental Unrest

steps.note: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts right beside Yala.
steps.title: Agitators

steps.note: Converts and Roiling Winds share the patch north of Yala. Kill both groups.
Signet of Akir drops from these converts. Brutes and Neophytes in the west camp drop it too.
Back to Yala for the follow-up quest.
steps.title: Agitators

steps.note: Bring word of the Al'Aketh back to Rorian. This closes the Yala chain.
steps.title: Return to Rorian

steps.note: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence, right beside this patch.
Back to Ventaari Brightwish near the watchtower.
steps.title: The Gift of Skysight

steps.note: Hand the Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro. Call of Earth continues.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Aetheen hands out the Earth Sapta. Follow the quest to the Minor Manifestation of Earth.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Drink the Earth Sapta at the Rise of Spirits, then return to the Minor Manifestation.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Bring the Rough Quartz back to Windshaper Boro in the grove.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Windshaper Boro: this earns your Earth Totem, a core Shaman tool.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Rorian: Skychain Belt or the Windblown Short Cloak, both small armour rewards.
steps.title: Return to Rorian

steps.note: Aetheen of the Gales: Rorian's next step, then the Foul Matriarch.
steps.title: Aetheen of the Gales

steps.note: Aetheen sends you after the Ursera Scavengers and the Urs'anah den.
steps.title: Aetheen of the Gales

steps.note: Foul Matriarch: Ursera Scavengers and Urs'anah are west of Aetheen. Long walk, bag check.
steps.title: Foul Matriarch

steps.note: Scrawny Ursera claws: Valreaa sends you to the Ursera patch west of her.
steps.title: Aggressive Encroachment

steps.note: Al'Aketh Thugs: Hanaa Nightwind sits in the west camp, with Brutes and Neophytes beside her.
steps.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

steps._review: W_MOB_LEVEL: the no-XP simulation reads the player as level 1 here. Ursera Scavengers are level 4, and the player is about level 3-4 at this point after the Thendal and Yala steps. Accepted.
steps.note: Kill 8 Ursera Scavengers around the den, south-west of Aetheen.
Scrawny Ursera beside the den. Collect 6 claws from them.

steps._review: W_MOB_LEVEL: same no-XP simulation artefact. Urs'anah is level 5 and sits at the far end of the Ursera den; the player is about level 4 here. Accepted, with the boss kept as the last objective.
steps.note: Urs'anah, the den mother, is further west. Her head completes the Foul Matriarch.

steps._review: W_MOB_LEVEL: the no-XP simulation reads level 1. Al'Aketh Brutes are level 4 and Malduko Cloudcrush level 5; the player is about level 4 here. Accepted, and Malduko is the one to skip if it is too hard.
steps.note: Brutes and Neophytes just south of the den; Malduko Cloudcrush is west of them.
Back to Hanaa Nightwind.
steps.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

steps.note: Valreaa Valewind: Thendal Ranger's Gloves are the armour pick here.

reward.why: Leather gloves: best early armour slot here (il 5). Belt and shoes are the alternatives.

steps.title: Aggressive Encroachment

steps.note: Back to Aetheen. Scout Ranger's Dagger is the weapon pick (Hunters: Refined Shortbow).

reward.why: Dagger for most melee: the clearest weapon step of the five. Hunters: Refined Shortbow instead.

steps.title: Foul Matriarch

steps.note: About level 4: the Thendal trainers are on the way out. Learn what you can afford.
The Next Step: walk south to Shen'dar Village and report to Constable Aonda.
steps.title: The Next Step

steps.note: The Adventurer: a breadcrumb to Raan Wildwind at the Shen'dar camp.
steps.title: The Adventurer

steps.note: Head south to Shen'dar Village, the second hub with the inn. Long walk, so check your bags first.
Constable Aonda: report in. The Highlands work starts from here.
steps.title: The Next Step

steps.note: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in the village, then return to Aonda.
steps.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

steps.note: Back to Constable Aonda for the village welcome.
steps.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

steps.note: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws on the south patch. Bag reward.
steps.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

steps.note: Restocking the Larders: Galestrider eggs and meat on the same south patch as the Prideclaws.
steps.title: Restocking the Larders

steps.note: Hunters: Veena Vericloud sells arrows and bullets here. Top up before the south patch.
Buy food and water from Coriella here. Mana users: extra water. Inn is here too.
Bind your hearthstone to Coriella's inn before the south patch.
Raan Wildwind: hand in the breadcrumb at the Shen'dar camp.
steps.title: The Adventurer

steps.note: Sit near Raan's campfire until you get the Boosted Rest buff.
steps.title: The Great Outdoors

steps.note: Sit at Raan's campfire until you get Boosted Rest. Use Raan's camp; DB spot is off.
Back to Raan Wildwind.
steps.title: The Great Outdoors

steps.note: Prideclaws roam the south patch; their pelts are the drop you need.
Galestriders and Strider Meat south of the village. Eggs are close by.
Back to Indari Sunseam. The Simple Leather Satchel is your first bag. Keep it.
steps.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

steps.note: Back to Zerril Softbreeze. Skywall Souffle is food for the trip.
steps.title: Restocking the Larders

steps.note: About level 5: the Shen'dar trainers are here, including the Mage trainer Shenaan Spellwind.
